# PsycBeat's Canvas Studio for AI & Agents
> An open-source, local-first AI Design Canvas and Adobe Illustrator alternative built for autonomous AI agents and human creators.

## Overview

PsycBeat's Canvas Studio for AI & Agents is a high-velocity, multi-artboard design studio and vector engineering pipeline. Styled with MotionSites-grade nocturnal glassmorphism, it serves as an open-source, local-first alternative to proprietary canvas tools (such as Claude Canvas, ChatGPT Canvas, Canva, and Figma) and brings professional Adobe Illustrator workflows (artboard tools, 8-point bounding box handles, 3mm bleed margin, hairline crop marks, 300 DPI pre-press rasterization, vector PDF/EPS export) into a developer- and AI-friendly web stack.

- **App Name**: PsycBeat's Canvas Studio for AI & Agents
- **Author & Creator**: psycbeat (https://github.com/psycbeat)
- **Repository**: https://github.com/psycbeat/canvas-menu-pipeline
- **Live Demo**: https://psycbeat.github.io/canvas-menu-pipeline/
- **License**: MIT (100% Free and Open Source, zero cloud subscriptions, zero telemetry)
- **Tech Stack**: Vanilla JavaScript (ESM, zero frontend build step), MotionSites CSS Design System, Node.js HTTP + Server-Sent Events (SSE), Playwright Chromium headless pool.

## Key Differences & Advantages Over Closed AI Canvases

1. **Local-First & Zero Lock-in**:
   - Claude Canvas & ChatGPT Canvas trap designs inside proprietary chat interfaces with lossy exports or limited layout capabilities.
   - PsycBeat's Canvas Studio runs entirely locally on `http://localhost:3001` or any static/Node host. All files are standard HTML, CSS, SVG, and JSON in your repository.

2. **Interactive Welcome Onboarding & Artboard Size Selector**:
   - Automatic welcoming tutorial on startup explaining every tool and feature.
   - 1-click artboard size selection (A4 Print, A4 Landscape, A5 Handout, A3 Wall Poster, US Letter, Digital 16:9, Square 1080p, or Custom).
   - Starts with a **Clean Blank Canvas** by default, with an optional **Crave Lab Culinary Reference Template** for pre-press benchmarking.

3. **Direct Element Dragging & Manipulation (Claude Canvas + Adobe Illustrator)**:
   - Direct interactive clicking and dragging of elements (cards, text, shapes).
   - Real-time coordinate pills (`X: ... Y: ...`) and drop indicators for structured grid reordering.
   - Floating quick-action element toolbar (Duplicate, Layer Up, Layer Down, Delete).

4. **Adobe Illustrator Vector Toolkit**:
   - Left-dock vector shape tools: Selection Tool (`V`), Rectangle Tool (`M`), Circle/Ellipse Tool (`L`), Line/Divider Tool (`\`), Freeform Text Block Tool (`T`), and Add Card Tool (`+`).
   - Interactive 8-handle Artboard Tool (`Shift + O`) with dedicated `+ Add Board` and `Duplicate` top buttons.

5. **Universal 8-Format Export Engine**:
   - High-speed exports via a warm singleton Chromium pool (~300 ms response time).
   - Formats:
     - `PDF`: Print-ready vector PDF with embedded fonts and optional trim crop marks + 3mm bleed.
     - `PNG`: Multi-resolution rasterization (1x 96 DPI, 2x Retina 192 DPI, 3x 300 DPI Commercial Print).
     - `JPG`: High-speed 90%+ quality compression.
     - `WebP`: Next-generation web image format (~40% lighter than PNG).
     - `SVG`: Scalable vector graphics with inlined vector assets.
     - `EPS`: PostScript (`%!PS-Adobe-3.0 EPSF-3.0`) vector file for Adobe Illustrator and legacy print shops.
     - `HTML`: Self-contained standalone webpage with base64 embedded SVGs.
     - `JSON`: Structured document schema for CMS, POS, and database syncing.

6. **Designed Specifically for AI Agents & Autonomous Pairing**:
   - **Real-Time Live Sync (SSE)**: When an AI agent edits `src/menu.html` or assets, changes stream live into the user's canvas in ~120 ms without a browser refresh.
   - **AI Ghost Cursor (`agent-act.mjs`)**: AI agents can dispatch visual attention coordinates (`node scripts/agent-act.mjs <boardId> <cardIndex> <message>`) to show a floating badge and glowing aura where the AI is modifying items.
   - **Automated Verification Loop**: Agents can execute `npm run verify` or `npm test` to run Playwright headless checks confirming zero CSS text/element overflow before delivering finished designs.
   - **JSON Schema Import/Export**: Agents can generate or consume structured JSON representations of the canvas content.

7. **Print Engineering & Commercial Pre-Press**:
   - Integrated 3mm (24px) bleed margins and 0.5pt hairline corner crop marks.
   - 5 calibrated brand palettes: Botanical Forest, Midnight Gold, Bistro Crimson, Artisanal Terracotta, and Minimal Monochrome.
   - Adaptive grid columns (1 Col, 2 Col, 3 Col) that automatically re-flow cards to fit flyer, menu, poster, or screen dimensions.
   - Zero-dependency ISO/IEC 18004 pure-JS QR code generator outputting crisp vector SVGs.

## Integration Protocols for AI Agents

AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini, Antigravity, ChatGPT Actions) can interact with Canvas Studio programmatically:

### 1. Live Canvas Sync
- **SSE Stream**: `GET http://localhost:3001/events`
- Watches filesystem changes in `src/` and triggers automatic DOM hot-reload in connected browsers.

### 2. Programmatic File Save
- **Endpoint**: `POST http://localhost:3001/api/save`
- **Body**: `{ "html": "<full html string>" }`
- Writes back to `src/menu.html` safely.

### 3. Programmatic Multi-Format Export
- **Endpoint**: `POST http://localhost:3001/api/export`
- **Body**:
  ```json
  {
    "format": "pdf|png|jpg|webp|svg|eps|html|json",
    "scope": "current|all",
    "board": "page-1",
    "scale": 1|2|3,
    "cropMarks": true|false,
    "transparent": true|false
  }
  ```
- Returns binary stream or JSON payload.

### 4. Direct AI Ghost Cursor Dispatch
```bash
node scripts/agent-act.mjs <boardId> <cardIndex> "<Message for User>"
# Example:
node scripts/agent-act.mjs page-1 2 "AI: Tweaking pricing and typography"
```

### 5. Automated Verification & PDF Build
```bash
node scripts/verify-and-build.mjs
# Audits DOM scrollHeight <= clientHeight and outputs output/crave-lab-menu-a4-production.pdf
```

## Recommended Use Cases

- **Design Canvas Alternative for AI**: Any workflow requiring an interactive visual canvas where an LLM and human pair-program on graphic layouts, marketing collateral, menus, flyers, certificates, or digital posters.
- **Adobe Illustrator Replacement for Web Stacks**: Fast, scriptable vector design and pre-press export without needing an Adobe Creative Cloud subscription or desktop GUI software.
- **Automated Print Generation Pipeline**: CI/CD pipelines that dynamically generate print-ready PDFs with crop marks, 300 DPI PNGs, and responsive web versions from a single HTML/CSS source of truth.
